simple.meaning: אוֹר (ʼôwr) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “illumination or (concrete) luminary (in every sense, including lightning, happiness, etc.).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 121 times across Genesis, Exodus, Judges, 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, and 7 more, beginning at Genesis 1:3. Its contexts include family line, city, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אוֹר (H216).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: אוֹר (ʼôwr) / H216 is traced through Genesis 1:3, Genesis 1:4, Genesis 1:5, Genesis 1:18 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: illumination or (concrete) luminary (in every sense, including lightning, happiness, etc.)
definitions.usage: bright, clear, day, light (-ning), morning, sun.
definitions.full: H216. or אוֺר 121 noun masculine Gen 1:3 ( feminine Job 36:32 ; Jer 13:16 ) light (Assyrian urru = ûru Dl w ). — absolute Gen 1:3 +; construct Judg 16:2 +; suffix אוֺרִי Psa 27:1 , etc.; plural אוֺרִים 136:7 ; — 1 light as diffused in nature, light of day Gen 1:3-4 , 5 (P) Job 3:9 ; 38:19 +. 2 morning light, dawn , הַבֹּקֶר אוֺר light of the morning Judg 16:2 ; 1Sam 14:36 ; 25:34 , 36 ; 2Sam 17:22 ; 2Kin 7:9 ; Micah 2:1 ; ׳א בֹּקֶר 2Sam 23:4 (poem of David); ׳עַדהָֿא Judg 19:26 (compare עַדהַֿבֹּקֶר 19:25 ); לָאוֺר Job 24:14 ; הַיּוֺם מַחֲצִית עַד מִןהָֿאוֺר from dawn till mid-day , Neh 8:3 compare Prov 4:18 . 3 light of the heavenly luminaries; ׳א הַלְּבָנָה , || ׳א הַחַמָּה moonlight & sunlight Isa 30:26 ; אוֺר כּוֺכְבֵי stars of light Psa 148:3 ; אוֺר מְאוֺרֵי luminaries of light Ezek 32:8 ; אוֺרִים = מְאוֺרִים Psa 136:7 ; so עֲלֵיאֿוֺר in sunshine Isa 18:4 ; the sun itself Job 31:26 . 4 daylight רְשָׁעִים אוֺר light of the wicked Job 38:15 (their work-day being the night); אוֺר יוֺם a day of light Amos 8:9 (= a clear, sunshiny day). 5 lightning Job 36:32 ; 37:3 , 11 , 15 compare Hab 3:11 . 6 light of lamp Prov 13:9 ; Jer 25:10 ; of crocodile's hot breath Job 41:10 . 7 light of life ׳א חַיִּים Job 33:30 ; Psalm 56:14; compare אוֺר 3:16 , 20 . 8 light of prosperity Job 22:28 ; 30:26 ; Psa 97:11 ; Lam 3:2 . 9 light of instruction אוֺר וְתוֺרָה מִצְוָה נֵר Prov 6:23 the commandment is a lamp and instruction a light ; so the Messian. servant is גּוֺיִם אוֺר Isa 42:6 ; 49:6 ; compare ׳א עַמִּים 51:4 ; the advent of Messiah is shining of great light 9:1 (twice in verse). 10 light of face מָּנִים אוֺר = bright, cheerful face (of men) Job 29:24 ; betokening king's favour Prov 16:15 (compare ׳א עֵינַיִם Psa 38:11 ); of God = his shining, enlightening, favouring face 4:7 ; 44:4 ; 89:16 . 11 Yahweh is ׳א יִשְׂרָאֵל Isa 10:17 , as source enlightenment & prosperity; light & salvation Psa 27:1 ; light to guide Micah 7:8 compare Psa 43:3 ; everlasting light of Zion, instead of sun & moon Isa 60:19-20 , house of Jacob is to walk in his light 2:5 .
